template: ts_decay_linear(if_else(greater(group_rank(ts_corr({of_owners_decile_rank_long}, {owners_decile_rank_long}, 60), group_cartesian_product(sector, bucket(rank(ts_mean(cap, 21)), "0,1,0.25"))), 0.9), quantile(ts_corr({of_owners_decile_rank_long}, {owners_decile_rank_long}, 60), driver="cauchy"), if_else(less(group_rank(ts_corr({of_owners_decile_rank_long}, {owners_decile_rank_long}, 60), group_cartesian_product(sector, bucket(rank(ts_mean(cap, 21)), "0,1,0.25"))), 0.1), reverse(quantile(ts_corr({of_owners_decile_rank_long}, {owners_decile_rank_long}, 60), driver="cauchy")), 0)), 5)
idea: 引入行业-市值二维分层与尾部拉伸：通过 group_cartesian_product 将行业（sector）与市值四分位（size quartile）交叉分组，消除大小盘风格对所有权相关性的结构性影响；仅在二维分组后的极值区域（前/后 10%）建仓，并使用 Cauchy 分布（quantile）对原始相关性进行非线性变换，将中间值压缩、极端值大幅拉伸，形成肥尾效应；5 日衰减控制事件驱动后的半衰期。
